introduction_markdown: General Certificate of Education (GCE) Board, Ordinary Level, June 2025. Additional Mathematics, Paper 2 (code 0575). Time allowed: two and a half hours. Answer ALL questions in SECTION A (Pure Mathematics, compulsory) and ANY TWO questions from EITHER SECTION B (Mechanics) OR SECTION C (Statistics and Probability). In Sections B and C, all questions carry equal marks. Candidates are expected to answer a combination of Section A and Section B OR Section A and Section C, but NOT a combination of all three. If Section B is chosen, Section C may not be chosen, and the other way round. All necessary working must be shown. No marks will be awarded for answers without brief statements showing how the answers have been obtained. Non-programmable electronic calculators and Mathematical Formulae booklets published by the GCE Board are allowed. Where necessary take g as 10 m s^-2.
enonce_intro_markdown:
A farmer plants yam in a farmland which is divided into 10 plots, and an average of 4500 FCFA is spent on fertilizer and labour on each plot. Given that the farmer harvests the yams from the 10 plots and sells each yam at an average of 2500 FCFA. The table below shows the harvest and the sales of the yams for the first 3 plots.

| Number of plots | Number of yams harvested | Amount per yam | Total selling price | Amount spent on fertilizer and labour | Income made by the farmer from each plot |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 20 | 2500 | 50000 | 4500 | 45500 |
| 2 | 24 | 2500 | 60000 | 4500 | 55500 |
| 3 | 28 | 2500 | 70000 | 4500 | 65500 |
incertitudes: Points : le sujet imprime des points par sous-question, sans total par question. Le champ points de l'exercice est la somme des points imprimes des sous-questions.

Enonce : l'ecriture imprimee est 'divided into10 plots' (espace manquant) et la phrase 'Given that the farmer harvests ... at an average of 2500 FCFA' est grammaticalement incomplete ; recopiee telle quelle. Le revenu par parcelle du tableau est bien egal au prix de vente moins 4500 (verifie).

questions.enonce_markdown: (a) Find the number of yams harvested from the $10^{\text{th}}$ plot. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The numbers of yams harvested, $20,\ 24,\ 28,\dots$, form an arithmetic progression with first term $a=20$ and common difference $d=4$.

$u_n=a+(n-1)d\Rightarrow u_{10}=20+9\times4=56.$

**56 yams were harvested from the 10th plot.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (b) Find the total selling price from the 10 plots. *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The selling prices $50\,000,\ 60\,000,\ 70\,000,\dots$ form an arithmetic progression with $a=50\,000$ and $d=10\,000$ (that is $4\times2500$).

$S_n=\dfrac n2\left[2a+(n-1)d\right]\Rightarrow S_{10}=\dfrac{10}{2}\left[2(50\,000)+9(10\,000)\right]=5\times190\,000=950\,000.$

Check with the number of yams: $S=2500\times(20+24+\dots+56)=2500\times380=950\,000$.

**The total selling price is $950\,000$ FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (c) Find the total income made from the farmland. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Income per plot $=$ selling price $-$ 4500 FCFA. For 10 plots the expenses are $10\times4500=45\,000$ FCFA.

Total income $=950\,000-45\,000=905\,000.$

Check with an arithmetic progression of incomes ($a=45\,500$, $d=10\,000$): $S_{10}=5\left[2(45\,500)+9(10\,000)\right]=5\times181\,000=905\,000$.

**The total income is $905\,000$ FCFA.**
